spec: C2SP signed-note / Go sumdb note format, as adopted by DES-06 and DES-07
note: The key-id derivation is checked against a published verifier key, so that half of the format is externally anchored rather than self-consistent: keyid = SHA-256(name + 0x0a || algorithm_byte || public_key)[0:4]. Algorithm 1 is Ed25519. Cross-implementation conformance for the signature itself — a real C2SP witness countersigning a Splitstick checkpoint — is FR-46's conformance suite in M3a; nothing here claims it.

keyid.source: the PeterNeumann verifier key published with the Go note package
keyid.name: PeterNeumann
